One of those Nord places, isn't it? You won't catch me anywhere near there. I think it's up to the northeast someplace.
Thirsk is a mead hall. It's just to the east of Lake Fjalding.
He served his purpose. That's all that matter.
I can't imagine he survived.... ah, well. He was cheap to hire.
I don't expect him to live through this. Of course, he doesn't know that. Just be sure you're not seen.

I believe he will have placed some weapons for you at the top of the mining office tower in the colony: a bow and a very potent poison arrow. I've also contributed a scroll that may help insure the arrow finds it's mark, and that you are not seen. I'd suggest remaining in the Mining Tower for safety. Once you're prepared, ready your bow to signal that Baslod should make his attack. He'll draw the guards away, and then you strike. With Falco assassinated, the colony should collapse in a very short time.
I do hope it meets your expectations.
Aldam Berendus will take care of the construction, %PCRank. Speak with him.

Yes. As I said, the plans were drawn up. A team was even assembled for construction. Aldam Berendus was placed in charge of it, I believe. If you find him at the site, he'll take care of the matter for you.
I put a lot of work into it. I hope you like it.
Should be done soon.
No, huh? Well, okay. There are two other spots, you know. One north of here, and one at the west end of the colony. Maybe you'd like one of those better?

What the Factor wants, the Factor gets. I'll see to it that work gets started real soon on this, but it'll probably take a few days to be completed. Just so you know. I'd say at least five, provided we're left alone to work. If you keep coming back, it may slow us down some.
No, huh? Well, okay. There are two other spots, you know. One south of here, and one at the west end of the colony. Maybe you'd like one of those better?
No, huh? Well, okay. There are two other spots, you know. Both of them are east of here. One's a little to the north, the other a little to the south. Maybe you'd like one of those better?
Okay. Now you have to be really sure this is the right spot. I don't want you to have second thoughts later on. Are you SURE you want it built here?
Off we go! Tell me when we're at the right spot.
Okay, you're the boss. Let me know if you change your mind.
Okay, you want me to follow you now? Just tell me when we're at the spot you want us to build at.

Well, it's a little complicated. At least, it is for me. So I've done as much as I can to make it real easy. See, there's three possible locations we could build on. You need to choose one. So I set up torches at each of the places; you just take me to the torch at the place you want it built at, and say the word. Let me know when you're ready to get started, and I'll follow you.
I hope it's to your liking.
Talk to Aldam Berendus, %PCName. He's in charge of the team that will be building it.

The plans for it have been on the table for quite some time. Carnius just never got around to doing anything about it; it was clear he never had any intention of staying. It's now your choice, however. I've put Aldam Berendus in charge of the construction team. You should find him and have him explain the situation to you.

Once, they were warriors much like the Skaal. Trapped and hungry on this island, they feasted on the flesh of their fallen comrades, which is a crime against nature. The All-Maker cursed them with undeath, forever doomed to walk the land in search of more of the flesh of man to consume.
Foul beasts, fit only to stain the blade of my axe. Once proud warriors, now the living dead. They are an abomination.
These creatures are abhorrent to the Skaal. They are cursed by the All-Maker for atrocities they committed in life. Stay away from these horrors, friend.
I haven't seen one, but they sound nasty. Undead Nords...that's not a pretty picture. The live ones smell bad enough.
I haven't seen one, but they sound nasty.
Ugh. And I thought the live Nords were bad. The dead ones are even worse, especially when they don't want to stay dead.
Imagine an angry Nord. Now imagine a dead angry Nord with a taste for human flesh. Get the picture?
Wolves are one of the most blessed of the All-Maker's creations. They are fast and agile, and they are careful and clever hunters.

I knew someone who tried to tame a wolf once. He used to raise guars so he thought he could use the same techniques. You know what? It almost worked...well, no, actually, it didn't work at all. The idiot owed me money, too.
They're all over this island. Some travel in packs, which makes them especially dangerous. I've heard some carry disease, as well.
I've heard there are rare white wolves around, but never actually seen one myself.
You'll find them all over this island. Be careful, though. Some of them carry diseases!
I needed him, and you killed him.
You've killed him, and you've ruined my plans because of it. I'm afraid I have no use further use for yout services.
I must say, I didn't expect you to kill him.
He and his companions should be arriving tonight. Head east along the coast; they're landing just to the east of the river's mouth.
Werewolves in the Greathall! Get in there quickly!
Quickly, into the Greathall! Some of the beasts ran inside!
All I ask is for a pair of boots. How hard could it be?
Hurry, hurry! Last boat to Solstheim! Until the next one. Hah-ha-hah.
All hail the new sheeftain of Thirshk! Becaushe of you, the mead hall ish open again! Here'sh to your health!
"In the cave she met the beast, and cut quite short its evil feast! And when the Udyrfrykte did fall, the chieftain came and claimed his hall!"
"In the cave he met the beast, and cut quite short its evil feast! And when the Udyrfrykte did fall, the chieftain came and claimed his hall!"
Be careful out here in the wild, friend. There's more roaming about than just wolves and bears.
Krr- AWWGH!  We can end your curse!  The wolf may walk no more!
By the Gods, it's good to see you again!
By the Gods, not you!  Get out of my house, cur!
You there! Can you help a warrior in trouble?
Did you see me? I fought like a wolf possessed! Ha!
Hello, friend. Have you met my love, Brandr?
I'd like you to meet Erna. We have a love my wife would never understand.
The Rite of the Wolf Giver is nearly complete! He he he he he he he he he.
My sisters and I must make our brew before the Rite can proceed.
With the proper ingredients, we can cure your lycanthropy, yes....
Wolfsbane, belladonna, and the purity of innocence are what we need. He he he he he he he.
Yaawwwnnn!  Inside, outside, I'll sleep anywhere.
Yawwwwwnn! Hello again my friend. Thanks to you, I can sleep again. Yawwwnnn.....
Behold the sea, friend. Never will you meet a maiden so beautiful...or unforgiving.
My lord, I can craft armor worthy of a chieftain!
Did you see the size of that beast!
Come, friend! I make the best armor on all of Solstheim.
To Sovngarde!
Enjoy our mead and kinship!
Candy, candy -- he makes so much! Uncle Sweetshare has a magic touch! So it's back to the workshop in the snow! With lovely lanterns all aglow! He he! Ha ho! He he he ha ha ho!
Well now, if you're not the comeliest lass I've ever laid eyes on. Come here, and let Big Erich keep you warm.
Keep your distance, friend, if you want to keep your head.
Thish is the besht mead hall anywhere, friend. You'll not find better in Shkyrim itshelf.
Welcome to Thirsk, friend! You should speak to Skjoldr Wolf-Runner. He is the chieftain of this hall, and wishes to meet all new arrivals.
Our mead ish the nectar of Shor himshelf, imported all the way from Shkyrim!
All hail the chieftain of Thirsk! Slayer of the Udyrfrykte! May the mead flow forever!
Thirsk is closed, and without a chieftain. These are sad times.
Watch yourself near Erich, friend.  He's a swine of a man.  It's too bad he's my clan brother....
Have you found it? Have you found the entrance to Sovngarde?
Our dark business is complete. Erna is dead! Hahahahahahahaha!
My husband is mine, do you understand me? Mine! That harlot Erna will pay!
Oddfrid tells me things, friend. Secret things.
They've taken my Oddfrid. My sweet, dear Oddfrid....
The forces of darkness are mine to command! All shall bow before the terrible power of Tymvaul the Dark!
My son.... My poor son.... Please, please help a sad old man.
The creatures have gone, and the lands are whole. Surely the All-Maker is pleased.
The Ristaag is complete. Praise be to the All-Maker.
You are not welcome here while you follow the path of the beast.
I know you have been infected by these werewolves.
I've only just arrived, and to this horror.
Travel back to the Skaal village. I will meet you there soon.
What of Aesliip, my friend?
Ah...you've arrived. These are strange times, my friend.
Greetings to you, wanderer. Why have you returned to our village?
You have returned. I would hear of your journey.
It is an honor, Blodskaal.
The Skaal will endure.
My greetings to you, wanderer.
What can this smith do for you? Armor, weapons? Some conversation?
Yes? I understand you are investigating Engar Ice-Mane's theft.
No time for talk. The Hunt has begun!
Let us fight through to the end.
This place! It is fit for a warrior like Heart-Fang!
You've returned from the lake! I trust you completed your task.
You are to prove your strength as a warrior of the Skaal.
You have done well, showing your loyalty and wisdom
You have shown your loyalty to the Skaal.
What do you want, stranger? Why are you among the Skaal?
There is no more to say to you, stranger. The Skaal wish you no harm, but you are not welcome here.
You've returned to our village, outlander. What is your business here?
The Spirit Bear is dead, and the Ristaag is nearly complete.
You and I must continue the Ristaag.
Come back at nightfall, my friend. We will perform the Ristaag.
Greetings, Blodskaal. Korst Wind-Eye has told me much about you.
Stay with Long-Tooth, Blodskaal. The Ristaag must be completed.
We must complete the Ristaag. The All-Maker demands this.
I am glad to see you alive!
It is good to see you again, friend.
I will wait here and defend this gate.
Be strong, my friend. You will persevere.
We must find our way through this maze.
This place is not of this world. I fear for our lives.
Have you found more information on the weapons being smuggled from the Fort?
Just another of life's little disappointments...
Ah, well. Duty calls.
Stuck here. Forever. I'll die.
Yes? What can this humble priest do for you?
I got nothing more to say.
You're back. And just in time!
We gotta find these guys. And smash 'em. Smash 'em good.
All is well here at Fort Frostmoth.
We must find Captain Carius. This place will fall to shambles without him.
Thank the gods you've returned!
Let us ferret out this ring of smugglers.
We'll have no dealings with the likes of you. Begone.
You'll not infect me with your Devilry! I am here to defend Nature, and I'll do so at any cost! Now begone!
Let's get a move on.
You chose Falco. Fine. Just leaves more for me.
Without me, it all falls to pieces.
Once more, with feeling...
What they don't know won't hurt them.
The Company does well, we get rich, and everyone is happy.
We'll whip this island into shape, and make it pay.
We'll show 'em how it's done.
One hand washes the other.
You scratch my back? I'll scratch yours.
Time is money. Let's get moving here.
Better. Just stick with it, and we'll all get rich.
Don't bother me with trivial details. Know what's important, and do it right the first time.
I can't believe it. Can't anyone do anything right?
Who cares about Nord crackpots? We got a lot to do here.
About time.
What is it?
You're with Carnius now. I'm sorry, but it was your choice.
Well, it couldn't get worse... Could it?
If it's not one thing, it's another.
Don't know what I'd do without you.
You're a lifesaver.
Between us, we just might pull this off.
No rest for the weary.
What next?
YOU'RE not the problem. You're doing fine... thank the Gods.
It's always something, isn't it?
Okay. The supply ship is fine. What else can go wrong?
Decisions are good. But good decisions are better.
Too bad about the ship. Not your fault, though.
Hroldar is gone, but we have other problems.
Good work with the ebony. Keep it up.
Hello! Are you here on assignment, or did you just stop by?
So, Carnius talked you into joining this little venture, did he?
I'm sorry, but I'm here on official business, and I don't have time to chat.
Well now. Have they finally sent someone to deliver the extra payment I requested?
Well, if it isn't you again. I daresay you're one of the nicest people I met, and that's saying quite a lot.
Raven Rock, the jewel of Solstheim.... For whatever that's worth.
Another day, another hundred piles of ore.
My lungs must be as black as these rocks by now.
May your ore be pure, and your profits large.
I'm listening; go ahead.
Please do something about my poor husband!
Yes? Did you want something?
Uh... there's a perfectly good explanation for this, I assure you...
The company's work is never done, friend.
This place isn't much, but I've forged the best of weapons with less.
Here to choose from our incredibly limited selection? What'll it be?
So old.... So weary.
There are garrisons all over Vvardenfell, but Fort Frostmoth is the only one around here.
I'm not a drinker myself.
Heard that got taken care of. About time.

I just hope you can figure out a way for things to go back to normal around here. It's depressing enough without having the benefit of the sweet spirits of the gods. Granted, I don't know which gods, but it must be one of them.
Heard you were looking into it. Hurry it up.
A bit of sujamma does me good. I won't forget this. You've been asking around about why this is a dry fort, right?
A bit of mazte does me good. I won't forget this. You've been asking around about why this is a dry fort, right?
A bit of flin does me good. I won't forget this. You've been asking around about why this is a dry fort, right?
A bit of Cyrodiilic Brandy does me good. I won't forget this. You've been asking around about why this is a dry fort, right?
A bit of shein does me good. I won't forget this. You've been asking around about why this is a dry fort, right?
A bit of greef does me good. I won't forget this. You've been asking around about why this is a dry fort, right?
Guess you don't have any more. I don't like being lied to.
Be that way. Fetcher.
I could use some more booze, but I'll talk to you. I understand you're looking to find out why this place became a dry fort.
I could use some booze, but I'll talk to you. I understand you're looking to find out why this place became a dry fort.
I heard you might have some sujamma on you. I could sure use a bit.
I heard you might have some mazte on you. I could sure use a bit.
I heard you might have some flin on you. I could sure use a bit.
I heard you might have some Cyrodiilic Brandy on you. I could sure use a bit.
I heard you might have some shein on you. I could sure use a bit.
I heard you might have some greef on you. I could sure use a bit.
